articles.title: As Strategy Sells Bitcoin, Strive Doubles Down With $4.2 Billion Offering
articles.snippet: Benchmark-StoneX analysts grew bullish towards Strive after the Bitcoin-buying asset manager padded cash reserves while growing its stockpile.

articles.title: Bitcoin Traders Flip Bearish as BTC Falls to Lowest Price in Months
articles.snippet: Myriad predictors think it's increasingly likely that Bitcoin's next stop is $55,000 rather than $84,000 as BTC continues its slide.
